text:
emily: Deploy-bot just flagged EU canary p95 +200ms and small error uptick.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p95=690ms (+220) over 5m; error_rate +1.9%. Suggested: PAUSE rollout. auto-rollback=false (maintenance tag).

rishi: Which change in this batch is the likely culprit? We had the kernel-quant flag and a telemetry agent bump.

leah: Kernel toggle + tiny cache tweak. I tested locally but not multi-az.

ops_oncall: Since auto-rollback is off, we need a manual decision. Recommend traffic slice 60/40 rollback to previous stable and pin the canary.

emily: Agreed. We should minimize customer impact and keep canary for investigation.

deploy-bot: CLI hints:
`redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --split 60:40 --to v2.3.8,v2.4.1`
`redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.4.1`

rishi: I'll run the split and tail logs for `cuda_sync_timeout` and `kv_cache_miss` across versions.

leah: I'll prepare a cherry-pick revert PR for the kernel toggle in parallel.

ops_oncall: Notify CS and SRE rotations: `@cs-eu` `@sre-oncall`. Draft customer note: short, status, no data loss, ETA 30m.

emily: Send the note and include monitor link. Proceed with split.

rishi: Executing traffic change now.

deploy-bot: action started (r-609876-01). Requested by rishi.

rishi: Applied. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-609876-01

10m later - rishi: p95 overall down to 520ms, stable. v2.3.8 ~500ms, v2.4.1 ~700ms.

leah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4402 (kernel revert). CI queued.

emily: If CI green, merge and redeploy to canary only. Do not promote automatically; keep health checks gated.

ops_oncall: Keeping 60/40 split for 30m. If revert fixes canary, we can roll remaining traffic. If not, escalate to full rollback.

rishi: Monitoring every 5m. Will post updates.

emily: Thanks team. Quick post-action: update release notes to mark kernel toggle temporarily disabled and add perf run checklist.

leah: Will update PR with release note snippet.

deploy-bot: status: partial rollback in effect, canary pinned. Auto-rollback still suppressed.

emily: Closing initial incident thread; will reopen if metrics regress. :thumbsup:
